abilities.name: Surveillance
abilities.text: Set a Faction Indicator anywhere on the battlefield. While Enemy Units are Within 6″ of this Faction Indicator, they lose HIDDEN Status.

abilities.name: Gravitic Boosters
abilities.text: Use after a Friendly Unit rolls a D6 for Charge Distance. Add 1 to the Charge Distance for this Unit.
